translations.web: Whatever thing I command you, that you shall observe to do. You shall not add to it, nor take away from it.
translations.bsb: See that you do everything I command you; do not add to it or subtract from it.
translations.kjv: What thing soever I command you, observe to do it: thou shalt not add thereto, nor diminish
translations.asv: What thing soever I command you, that shall ye observe to do: thou shalt not add thereto, nor diminish from it.
